Input:

Translate exactly and literally
Do not add, remove, infer, or reinterpret any information

nodes.name: Get ticket status
nodes.notes: Re-reads the ticket immediately before any write. Do not trust status passed in from the caller - stale caller data is the exact failure mode this guards against.

nodes.name: Ticket not solved or closed?
nodes.notes: Base status only - new/open/pending/hold pass, solved/closed are blocked.

nodes.name: Skip: ticket already solved or closed
nodes.notes: Terminal. Reached when a duplicate or replayed webhook targets a ticket the automation has already finished. No Zendesk write on purpose.

parameters.content:
## Status guard

Blocks all writes when the ticket is already `solved` or `closed`.

Added after 2026-07-23: Zendesk redelivered a `ticket created` webhook 8h37m late, the automation re-ran on the original email and contradicted its own earlier reply.

Uses the base `status` string, so no `cs_project_config` column is needed and `closed` is covered for free.

Safe for legitimate follow-ups: Zendesk auto-reopens a solved ticket on requester reply, so status is `open` by the time the 2nd-message flow calls this.
